mapper.select: SELECT t.username AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, SUM(t.cnt) AS count FROM ( SELECT owner_user AS username, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sale_lead WHERE deleted=0 AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status IN (1,2) AND next_follow_time >= #{dayStart} AND next_follow_time < #{dayEnd} AND owner_user IN #{u} GROUP BY owner_user UNION ALL SELECT owner_user AS username, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND customer_type=1 AND next_follow_time >= #{dayStart} AND next_follow_time < #{dayEnd} AND owner_user IN #{u} GROUP BY owner_user ) t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=t.username AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 GROUP BY t.username ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sale_lead l WHERE l.deleted=0 AND l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.status IN (1,2) AND ( (l.last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND l.last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{leadTo} DAY AND l.last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{leadFrom} - 1) DAY) OR (l.last_follow_time IS NULL AND l.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{leadTo} DAY AND l.create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{leadFrom} - 1) DAY) ) AND l.owner_user IN #{u}
) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND customer_type=1 AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN (3, 4)) AND ( (last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{custTo} DAY AND last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{custFrom} - 1) DAY) OR (last_follow_time IS NULL AND create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{custTo} DAY AND create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{custFrom} - 1) DAY) ) AND owner_user IN #{u})

SELECT t.username AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, SUM(t.cnt) AS count FROM ( SELECT l.owner_user AS username, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM sale_lead l WHERE l.deleted=0 AND l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.status IN (1,2) AND ( (l.last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND l.last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{leadTo} DAY AND l.last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{leadFrom} - 1) DAY) OR (l.last_follow_time IS NULL AND l.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{leadTo} DAY AND l.create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{leadFrom} - 1) DAY) ) AND l.owner_user IN #{u}
GROUP BY l.owner_user UNION ALL SELECT owner_user AS username, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND customer_type=1 AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN (3, 4)) AND ( (last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{custTo} DAY AND last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{custFrom} - 1) DAY) OR (last_follow_time IS NULL AND create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{custTo} DAY AND create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{custFrom} - 1) DAY) ) AND owner_user IN #{u} GROUP BY owner_user ) t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=t.username AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 GROUP BY t.username ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT c.owner_user AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.last_follow_time, c.create_time) >= NOW() - INTERVAL 13 DAY AND COALESCE(c.last_follow_time, c.create_time) < NOW() - INTERVAL 6 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count7, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.last_follow_time, c.create_time) >= NOW() - INTERVAL 29 DAY AND COALESCE(c.last_follow_time, c.create_time) < NOW() - INTERVAL 13 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count14, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.last_follow_time, c.create_time) < NOW() - INTERVAL 29 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count30 FROM customer_info c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=c.owner_user AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.customer_type=1 AND (c.status IS NULL OR c.status NOT IN (3, 4)) AND c.owner_user IN #{u} GROUP BY c.owner_user HAVING (count7+count14+count30) > 0 ORDER BY count30 DESC, count14 DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(last_follow_time, create_time) >= NOW() - INTERVAL 13 DAY AND COALESCE(last_follow_time, create_time) < NOW() - INTERVAL 6 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count7, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(last_follow_time, create_time) >= NOW() - INTERVAL 29 DAY AND COALESCE(last_follow_time, create_time) < NOW() - INTERVAL 13 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count14, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(last_follow_time, create_time) < NOW() - INTERVAL 29 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count30 FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND customer_type=1 AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN (3, 4)) AND owner_user IN #{u}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sale_lead WHERE deleted=0 AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status IN (1,2) AND owner_user IN #{u} AND last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND next_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND next_follow_time >= last_follow_time AND ( next_follow_time < last_follow_time + INTERVAL 1 DAY OR next_follow_time < CURDATE() )) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND customer_type=1 AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN (3, 4)) AND owner_user IN #{u} AND last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND next_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND next_follow_time >= last_follow_time AND ( next_follow_time < last_follow_time + INTERVAL 1 DAY OR next_follow_time < CURDATE() ))

SELECT id, lead_name AS name, contact_name, phone, owner_user, owner_user_name, last_follow_time, next_follow_time, create_time FROM sale_lead WHERE deleted=0 AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status IN (1,2) AND next_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND next_follow_time >= #{dayStart} AND next_follow_time < #{dayEnd} AND owner_user IN #{u} ORDER BY next_follow_time ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT id, customer_name AS name, contact_name, phone, owner_user, owner_user_name, last_follow_time, next_follow_time, create_time FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND customer_type=1 AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN (3, 4)) AND next_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND next_follow_time >= #{dayStart} AND next_follow_time < #{dayEnd} AND owner_user IN #{u} ORDER BY next_follow_time ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT id, lead_name AS name, contact_name, phone, owner_user, owner_user_name, last_follow_time, next_follow_time, create_time, '线索' AS entity_type, CASE WHEN next_follow_time < last_follow_time + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN '计划时间无效' ELSE '未按计划跟进' END AS abnormal_type FROM sale_lead WHERE deleted=0 AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND status IN (1,2) AND owner_user IN #{u} AND last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND next_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND next_follow_time >= last_follow_time AND ( next_follow_time < last_follow_time + INTERVAL 1 DAY OR next_follow_time < CURDATE() ) UNION ALL SELECT id, customer_name AS name, contact_name, phone, owner_user, owner_user_name, last_follow_time, next_follow_time, create_time, '客户' AS entity_type, CASE WHEN next_follow_time < last_follow_time + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN '计划时间无效' ELSE '未按计划跟进' END AS abnormal_type FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND customer_type=1 AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN (3, 4)) AND owner_user IN #{u} AND last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND next_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND next_follow_time >= last_follow_time AND ( next_follow_time < last_follow_time + INTERVAL 1 DAY OR next_follow_time < CURDATE() ) ) t ORDER BY abnormal_type, next_follow_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sale_lead l WHERE l.deleted=0 AND l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.status IN (1,2) AND l.owner_user IN #{u} AND ( (l.last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND l.last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND l.last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) OR (l.last_follow_time IS NULL AND l.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND l.create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND customer_type=1 AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN (3, 4)) AND owner_user IN #{u} AND ( (last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) OR (last_follow_time IS NULL AND create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) )

SELECT l.id, l.lead_name AS name, l.contact_name, l.phone, l.owner_user, l.owner_user_name, l.last_follow_time, l.next_follow_time, l.create_time, (#{threshold} - DATEDIFF(NOW(), COALESCE(l.last_follow_time, l.create_time))) AS remain_days FROM sale_lead l WHERE l.deleted=0 AND l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.status IN (1,2) AND l.owner_user IN #{u} AND ( (l.last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND l.last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND l.last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) OR (l.last_follow_time IS NULL AND l.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND l.create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) )
ORDER BY remain_days ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT id, customer_name AS name, contact_name, phone, owner_user, owner_user_name, last_follow_time, next_follow_time, create_time, (#{threshold} - DATEDIFF(NOW(), COALESCE(last_follow_time, create_time))) AS remain_days FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND customer_type=1 AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN (3, 4)) AND owner_user IN #{u} AND ( (last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) OR (last_follow_time IS NULL AND create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{warnToDays} DAY AND create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{warnFromDays} - 1) DAY) ) ORDER BY remain_days ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT o.create_by AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.create_time >= #{dayStart} AND o.create_time < #{dayEnd} THEN o.customer_id END) AS today, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.create_time >= #{weekStart} AND o.create_time < #{weekEnd} THEN o.customer_id END) AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.create_time >= #{monthStart} AND o.create_time < #{monthEnd} THEN o.customer_id END) AS month FROM orders o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=o.create_by AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 WHERE o.status='PAID' AND o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND o.create_time >= #{monthStart} AND o.create_time < #{monthEnd} AND o.create_by IN #{u} GROUP BY o.create_by ORDER BY month DESC, week DESC

SELECT l.owner_user AS username, MAX(usr.real_name) AS real_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS leads, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.id END) AS deals FROM sale_lead l LEFT JOIN customer_info c ON c.lead_id = l.id AND c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.customer_type=1 LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.status='PAID' LEFT JOIN sys_user usr ON usr.username = l.owner_user AND usr.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND usr.deleted=0 WHERE l.deleted=0 AND l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.create_time >= #{start} AND l.create_time < #{end} AND l.owner_user IN #{u} GROUP BY l.owner_user ORDER BY leads DESC, deals DESC

SELECT o.create_by AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.final_amount),0) AS amount, ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(NOW(), o.create_time)), 1) AS avg_age_days FROM orders o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=o.create_by AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 WHERE o.status='PENDING' AND o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.create_by IN #{u} GROUP BY o.create_by ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT o.create_by AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('REFUNDED','REFUNDING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('REFUNDED','REFUNDING') THEN o.final_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS refund_amount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('REFUNDED','REFUNDING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS refund_rate FROM orders o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=o.create_by AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time < #{end} AND o.create_by IN #{u} GROUP BY o.create_by HAVING refund_count > 0 ORDER BY refund_amount DESC

SELECT bucket AS label, SUM(cnt) AS count FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(last_follow_time, create_time) >= CURDATE() THEN '今日' WHEN COALESCE(last_follow_time, create_time) >= NOW() - INTERVAL 3 DAY THEN '1-3 天' WHEN COALESCE(last_follow_time, create_time) >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN '4-7 天' WHEN COALESCE(last_follow_time, create_time) >= NOW() - INTERVAL 14 DAY THEN '8-14 天' WHEN COALESCE(last_follow_time, create_time) >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN '15-30 天' ELSE '30 天以上' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND customer_type=1 AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN (3, 4)) AND owner_user IN #{u} GROUP BY bucket ) t GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY FIELD(bucket,'今日','1-3 天','4-7 天','8-14 天','15-30 天','30 天以上')

SELECT o.create_by AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time,'%Y-%m') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(o.final_amount),0) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=o.create_by AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 WHERE o.status='PAID' AND o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time < #{end} AND o.create_by IN #{u} GROUP BY o.create_by, month ORDER BY o.create_by, month

SELECT t.username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, SUM(t.curr_amount) AS curr_amount, SUM(t.prev_amount) AS prev_amount, SUM(t.curr_count) AS curr_count, SUM(t.prev_count) AS prev_count FROM ( SELECT create_by AS username, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{currStart} AND create_time < #{currEnd} THEN final_amount ELSE 0 END) AS curr_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{prevStart} AND create_time < #{prevEnd} THEN final_amount ELSE 0 END) AS prev_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{currStart} AND create_time < #{currEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curr_count, SUM(CASE WHEN create_time >= #{prevStart} AND create_time < #{prevEnd} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_count FROM orders WHERE status='PAID' AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND create_time >= #{prevStart} AND create_time < #{currEnd} AND create_by IN #{u} GROUP BY create_by ) t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=t.username AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 GROUP BY t.username

SELECT o.create_by AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS real_name, COALESCE(AVG(o.final_amount),0) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=o.create_by AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 WHERE o.status='PAID' AND o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.create_time >= #{start} AND o.create_time < #{end} AND o.create_by IN #{u} GROUP BY o.create_by ORDER BY avg_amount DESC

SELECT t.source AS source, t.username AS username, MAX(u.real_name) AS top_member_name, t.converted AS converted FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(source,'未知') AS source, owner_user AS username, SUM(CASE WHEN status=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS converted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(source,'未知') ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN status=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS rn FROM sale_lead WHERE deleted=0 AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND create_time >= #{start} AND create_time < #{end} AND owner_user IN #{u} GROUP BY source, owner_user ) t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.username=t.username AND u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.deleted=0 WHERE t.rn=1 GROUP BY t.source, t.username, t.converted

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sale_lead l WHERE l.deleted=0 AND l.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND l.status IN (1,2) AND l.owner_user=#{username} AND ( (l.last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND l.last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{leadTo} DAY AND l.last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{leadFrom} - 1) DAY) OR (l.last_follow_time IS NULL AND l.create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{leadTo} DAY AND l.create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{leadFrom} - 1) DAY) )
) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND customer_type=1 AND owner_user=#{username} AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN (3, 4)) AND ( (last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND last_follow_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{custTo} DAY AND last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{custFrom} - 1) DAY) OR (last_follow_time IS NULL AND create_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{custTo} DAY AND create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL (#{custFrom} - 1) DAY) )) AS about_recycle_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_info WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND customer_type=1 AND owner_user=#{username} AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN (3, 4)) AND ( (last_follow_time IS NOT NULL AND last_follow_time < NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) OR (last_follow_time IS NULL AND create_time < NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) )) AS stale_count
